name: Digital India Programme, 2015
change: A nationwide initiative to build digital infrastructure, expand internet connectivity, and deliver government services online through platforms like Aadhaar, UPI, and DigiLocker.
impact: Transforms governance and public service delivery through digital platforms. However, challenges remain in cybersecurity and bridging the digital divide.

name: IndiaAI Mission, 2024
change: A national initiative to develop AI infrastructure, including GPU clusters, AI research funding, and development of indigenous large language models.
impact: Accelerates AI innovation and strengthens India’s position in global AI development. Requires strong governance for ethical AI use.

name: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
change: Introduces regulations for collection, processing, and storage of personal data with user consent, accountability, and penalties for misuse.
impact: Enhances user privacy and trust in digital systems but increases compliance burden for organizations.

name: Information Technology Act Amendment Framework, 2021
change: Updated intermediary guidelines and digital media regulations to control online content, strengthen platform accountability, and regulate social media.
impact: Improves regulation of online platforms but raises concerns about freedom of expression and over-regulation.

name: National Cyber Security Strategy, 2020
change: Framework for protecting critical digital infrastructure, enhancing cyber defense mechanisms, and promoting AI-based threat detection systems.
impact: Strengthens national security and digital resilience. Requires continuous upgrades due to evolving cyber threats.

name: Semiconductor Mission Policy, 2021
change: Provides incentives and infrastructure support for semiconductor manufacturing and chip design in India.
impact: Reduces dependency on imports and boosts domestic tech manufacturing ecosystem.

name: National Blockchain Strategy, 2022
change: Promotes adoption of blockchain technology in governance, supply chain management, and financial systems.
impact: Enhances transparency and security in digital transactions but requires regulatory clarity.

name: 5G Deployment Policy, 2022
change: Rollout of 5G spectrum and infrastructure to enable high-speed connectivity and support IoT, AI, and smart city applications.
impact: Enables next-generation technologies and innovation. Requires significant investment in infrastructure.

name: Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC), 2021
change: Creation of an open digital network to decentralize e-commerce and allow small businesses to participate in online marketplaces.
impact: Reduces monopoly of large platforms and promotes competition and inclusivity in digital commerce.

name: AI Ethics and Governance Framework, 2025
change: Establishes guidelines for ethical AI development, including fairness, transparency, accountability, and bias mitigation in AI systems.
impact: Ensures responsible AI adoption and builds trust in automated systems. Requires enforcement and monitoring mechanisms.
